image_compressor.question: Can you compress images without losing quality?
image_compressor.answer: Yes. Lossless compression keeps every pixel identical (usually 10-30% smaller). Lossy compression at quality 75-85 looks virtually identical to the human eye while reducing file size by 50-80%.

image_compressor.question: What is the best quality setting for web images?
image_compressor.answer: For photographs use quality 75-85 (80 is the sweet spot). For logos and graphics with few colors use lossless compression.

image_compressor.question: Is the ToolBoxy Image Compressor free?
image_compressor.answer: Yes, completely free. No signup, no limits, no watermark.

image_compressor.question: Are my images uploaded to your servers?
image_compressor.answer: No. ToolBoxy is designed so supported image tools process data in your browser. Your files stay on your device.

image_compressor.question: Does compressing images improve SEO?
image_compressor.answer: Yes. Smaller images load faster, which improves Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) — one of Google’s Core Web Vitals ranking factors.

emi_calculator.question: How is EMI calculated?
emi_calculator.answer: EMI = [P × R × (1+R)^N] / [(1+R)^N – 1] where P is principal, R is monthly interest rate, and N is number of months.

emi_calculator.question: Is this EMI calculator accurate for Nepal banks?
emi_calculator.answer: Yes. It uses the standard reducing-balance method used by commercial banks in Nepal.

emi_calculator.question: Can I calculate home loan, car loan and personal loan EMI?
emi_calculator.answer: Yes. Enter any loan amount, interest rate and tenure to get monthly EMI, total interest and total repayment.
